title: Event | IETDS · 16th CEFE Forum: New Trends in Financial Talent for the Digital-Intelligence Era
summary: Finance sits at a digital-transformation crossroads; AI is remaking every service layer — and the talent mix with it. Institutions need dual-fluent people: finance + AI/data.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event / Forum promo · November 1, 2024 · Inventory type: interview

Finance sits at a digital-transformation crossroads; AI is remaking every service layer — and the talent mix with it. Institutions need dual-fluent people: finance + AI/data.

Summit

  • AI + Education Innovation & Talent Development Summit
  • When: November 20–21, 2024
  • Where: Zhongguancun International Innovation Center, Beijing
  • Scale: 2,000+ industry, campus, enterprise, media attendees expected

Featured track (Nov 21 afternoon)

Hosted by the Finance Committee of the China Association for Educational Technology: “New Trends in Financial Talent Development in the Digital-Intelligence Era.”

  • Leader / academic / tech insights on AI in finance — applications, challenges, opportunities
  • Practice cases: robo-advisory, risk, quant trading, and more
  • Curriculum, pedagogy, and practice-ability innovation for next-gen finance talent
  • Roundtables and Q&A
  • Book launch: Breaking Through · Building for the Future — New Trends in Financial Talent in the Digital-Intelligence Era

Seven parallel tracks

AI × industry-education integration · enterprise smart learning & org change · digital humans · AI × training · AI + pharma/health talent · digital-intelligence education upgrade · smart Party-building paradigms.

— END —
